opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead research and draft recruiting email
opportunities.description: For a given GitHub username, search the user, open their profile and top repo, then draft an email to hiring@example.com with a lead summary (followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post).
steps: Click GitHub search, type username, press Enter
Open the matching user profile and note followers and latest post
Open the top repository and note stars and language
Open mail compose and enter the hiring address
Type body with followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post
